name: Aesan Protector's On Enter returns a friendly ally to hand
notes: Aesan Protector's element is WIND, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WIND champion (Spirit of Wind), same as deployment-beacon-summon-drone/reclaim-return-ally/winds-of-retribution-ally-buff. A separate Dungeon Guide is seeded onto our own field as the On Enter return-to-hand target. Only the On Enter is covered; Intercept is a combat-redirect passive that requires a real attack and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Return target ally you control to its owner's hand.
